en.headline: Centre for Health Protection assesses Russian pneumonia case as low risk
en.dek: The centre said there is no evidence of sustained transmission and it has stepped up health monitoring of arrivals from Russia at the airport.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Monday that a laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Siberia, who died earlier this month from severe pneumonia of unknown cause poses a low immediate public health risk to Hong Kong.

The centre noted that the World Health Organization, citing information from Russian authorities, has found no evidence of sustained transmission linked to the case. Russian authorities reported that the laboratory where the worker was employed had no biosafety incident, contacts tested negative for high-threat pathogens, and no other related severe pneumonia cases were identified. The centre has received no reports in recent months of people arriving from Russia with unexplained pneumonia.

As a precaution, the centre has strengthened health monitoring of relevant flights from Russia at Hong Kong International Airport. Port health staff are conducting temperature screening at the gates and assessing passengers who show symptoms.
The centre said it will continue to monitor developments closely and take further measures if needed to prevent any imported cases.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心：俄羅斯不明肺炎個案對港即時風險低
zh.dek: 中心指未有持續傳播證據，已加強在機場對俄羅斯抵港旅客的健康監測。
body: 衛生署衛生防護中心周一表示，俄羅斯西伯利亞伊爾庫茨克州一間實驗室一名職員早前因不明原因嚴重肺炎死亡，對本港公共衛生構成的即時風險屬於低。
中心指出，世界衛生組織根據俄方資料評估，目前未發現與事件相關的持續傳播證據。俄方表示死者工作的實驗室沒有發生生物安全事故，接觸者化驗未檢出高威脅病原體，亦未發現其他相關嚴重肺炎個案。中心近月沒有接獲從俄羅斯抵港人士罹患不明原因肺炎的呈報。
為審慎起見，中心已加強在香港國際機場對俄羅斯抵港相關航班的旅客進行健康監測，包括安排港口衛生科人員在閘口為旅客量度體溫，並對出現病徵者進行健康評估。
中心表示會繼續密切監察事態發展，嚴防輸入個案，以保障市民健康。
